bible_verses.telugu: దేవా, నా దేవుడవు నీవే, వేకువనే నిన్ను వెదకుదును
bible_verses.english: You, God, are my God, earnestly I seek you; I thirst for you, my whole being longs for you, in a dry and parched land where there is no water.

bible_verses.telugu: నేనిచ్చు నీళ్లు త్రాగు వాడెప్పుడును దప్పిగొనడు; నేను వానికిచ్చు నీళ్లు నిత్యజీవమునకై వానిలో ఊరెడి నీటి బుగ్గగా ఉండునని ఆమెతో చెప్పెను.
bible_verses.english: but whoever drinks the water I give them will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give them will become in them a spring of water welling up to eternal life.
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be filled.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, I come to You today on my knees, admitting how deeply I need Your presence. My soul thirsts for You in the dry places of my life. Wash over me with Your grace, and let the sweetness of Your forgiveness restore my joy. Fill me anew with Your living water so that I may walk with renewed hope. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, I come to You today on my knees, admitting how deeply I need Your presence. My soul thirsts for You in the dry places of my life. devotional.reflection_english: Life often leads us through dry and weary deserts where our strength falters and our spirits feel parched. In those humble moments of desperate longing, Jesus meets us not with judgment, but with the refreshing grace of His presence. His forgiveness is a soul-quenching stream, sweeter than anything this world can offer. Today, bring your emptiness to Him, knowing that the One who promises living water will faithfully satisfy every thirsty heart.
